info.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
info.description: API spec for Microsoft.Security (Microsoft Defender for Cloud) resource provider — pricingBatch resource type

get.description: Gets the current pricing batch configuration for the specified scope.

default.description: Error response describing why the operation failed.

put.description: Updates multiple Microsoft Defender for Cloud pricing configurations for the specified subscription scope. This operation uses a best-effort approach where valid plans are saved atomically, while invalid plans return detailed error information. Only subscription-level scopes are supported. Maximum of 30 pricing plans can be updated in a single request.

default.description: Error response describing why the operation failed.

PricingBatch.description: Pricing batch resource for updating multiple pricing plan configurations in a single operation.

PricingBatchProperties.description: Properties for a pricing batch operation

plansConfigurations.description: Array of pricing plan configurations to update. Maximum of 30 plans allowed per request.

results.description: Results for each individual pricing plan update within the batch operation

summary.description: Summary statistics for the batch operation including total, successful, and failed update counts

PricingBatchPlanItem.description: Individual pricing plan configuration for batch update operation

planName.description: Name of the pricing plan (e.g., VirtualMachines, StorageAccounts, CloudPosture, Containers, etc.)

properties.description: Pricing configuration properties for this plan

PricingBatchResult.description: Result of updating a single pricing plan within a batch operation

planName.description: Name of the pricing plan that was processed

success.description: Whether the update for this pricing plan was successful

errorMessage.description: Detailed error message if the update failed (only present when success=false)

result.description: Updated pricing configuration resource (only present when success=true)

PricingBatchSummary.description: Summary statistics for batch operation results

totalRequested.description: Total number of pricing configurations requested for update

successfulUpdates.description: Number of pricing configurations successfully updated

failedUpdates.description: Number of pricing configurations that failed to update

PricingBatchName.name: pricingBatchName
PricingBatchName.description: Name of the pricing batch configuration

PricingBatchBody.name: pricingBatch
PricingBatchBody.description: Pricing batch resource containing multiple plan configurations (maximum 30 plans per request)
